EventSummary.description:
The event a "wake me" trigger brought into the chat (features/triggers): the
message is the system's, not the user's, and is shown as an event card.

FilterChip.title: FilterChip
FilterChip.description: A filter typed into the query (`client:ludmyla-doula`, `in:tech-services`).

FocusSettings.title: FocusSettings
FocusSettings.description: The focus timer (Focus page, Home widget, Dynamic Island).

FocusTimerState.title: FocusTimerState
FocusTimerState.description: The focus timer's state (frontend `features/focus/timer.ts`), times in epoch ms.

FolderDefaults.title: FolderDefaults
FolderDefaults.description: Properties a new document in `folder` (or below it) starts with.

FramePictureOut.title: FramePictureOut
FramePictureOut.description: A picture of the package, for ``, CSS `url()` and `anemo.files.url()`.

results.title: Results
results.description: One per entry tried or skipped, newest first (undone ones are left out)

HomeSettings.title: HomeSettings
HomeSettings.description: The Home page layouts: one for wider screens, one for phones (one column).

HookAccepted.title: HookAccepted
HookAccepted.description: Nothing about the trigger or its automation: only that the request was taken.

ImageSettings.title: ImageSettings
ImageSettings.description:
The generate_image tool (features/image_generation). Security-sensitive like the
permissions: it decides how much an agent may spend without asking.

LinkGroups.title: LinkGroups
LinkGroups.description: Links grouped by the type of the item at the other end.

ref.title: Ref

title.title: Title
title.description: Empty when it is gone for good

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: A document's path, a task's status, an event's start

state.title: State

LinkItem.title: LinkItem
LinkItem.description: An item at one end of a link, as it is now.

detail.title: Detail

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: explicit: set on the task or event (can be removed); inline: a link in its text (edit the text to change it)

MarkReadIn.title: MarkReadIn
MarkReadIn.description: Mark these as read; with no ids, everything.

MessageVersion.title: MessageVersion
MessageVersion.description: One answer to the same message; Regenerate adds one.

ModelDefaults.title: ModelDefaults
ModelDefaults.description:
Which model handles each kind of work. Unset tasks fall back to the chat model
(except embeddings, transcription and image, which need a model of their own kind).

MusicSettings.title: MusicSettings
MusicSettings.description: How the music player looks and talks.

NavigationSettings.title: NavigationSettings
NavigationSettings.description:
Where each page of the app goes (Settings > Pages): in the sidebar's list, behind
"More", or off. A page that is off is not in any menu or in search, and the agents
don't get its tools (tools/registry.py: FEATURE_TOOLS). A page in none of the lists
(one added in a later version) is shown under "More".

OccurrenceIn.title: OccurrenceIn
OccurrenceIn.description: Change or cancel one occurrence of a repeating event.

OccurrenceOut.description:
One occurrence in a calendar range. For repeating events `original_start`
identifies it (used to change or cancel just this one).

OptionPatch.title: OptionPatch
OptionPatch.description: Only the fields that are sent change; `hub_document_id: null` removes the hub.

PageIn.title: PageIn
PageIn.description:
A web page attached to a message by the browser extension: its main content (or a
selection, a PDF's text, a video transcript). Untrusted: it is wrapped and labelled as
data for the model (runtime/pages.py) and never becomes part of the message text.

PageSummary.title: PageSummary
PageSummary.description: The page attached to a message, without its content (GET …/page has it).

PendingApproval.title: PendingApproval
PendingApproval.description: An approval one of the automation's runs is waiting for.

PhaseEndedIn.title: PhaseEndedIn
PhaseEndedIn.description: The timer finished a phase in a browser (for the Notifications list).

PlayerState.title: PlayerState
PlayerState.description:
The player as its tab reports it. `index`: the current track's place in `queue`
(0-based; meaningless when the queue is empty).

PluginBuildChatOut.title: PluginBuildChatOut
PluginBuildChatOut.description: The chat "Continue building with the assistant" started (POST /{plugin}/chat).

message.title: Message
message.description: What the user wants changed. Left out: the assistant reads the plugin and asks.

PluginSettings.title: PluginSettings
PluginSettings.description:
Settings > Plugins (docs/specs/CONTRACTS-plugins.md §5). Not sensitive: switching
every plugin off must be quick.

PluginSource.title: PluginSource
PluginSource.description:
Where a plugin came from: an uploaded zip (its file name), a Git repository (URL,
ref, the commit it was fetched at), an assistant (the chats) or Anemo itself.

drawing_hash.title: Drawing Hash
drawing_hash.description: The drawing version the image shows

ProfileSettings.title: ProfileSettings
ProfileSettings.description:
Settings > Profile: how you appear in the app. The avatar is set through
PUT /appearance/avatar, which also stores its id here.

PropertySettings.title: PropertySettings
PropertySettings.description:
Document properties (Settings > Properties). The definitions themselves are rows
of their own (features/properties); this holds the folder defaults.

PushKeyOut.title: PushKeyOut
PushKeyOut.description: The server's VAPID public key, for PushManager.subscribe().

PushSubscriptionIn.title: PushSubscriptionIn
PushSubscriptionIn.description: What the browser's PushSubscription.toJSON() gives, plus a name for the device.

QuestionMark.title: QuestionMark
QuestionMark.description:
The agent stopped to ask something: `at` is where in the answer's text (a
character offset, before the text that came after the answer).

ReferenceSummary.title: ReferenceSummary
ReferenceSummary.description: Another chat that was attached to a message as context.

ReorderIn.title: ReorderIn
ReorderIn.description: The tasks of one board column, in their new order (moves them to `status`).

actor.description: Who saved it (None on older revisions)
Who saved it (None on older revisions)

RunChange.title: RunChange
RunChange.description: Something a run changed, recorded by the server from its tool calls.

RunEvent.title: RunEvent
RunEvent.description: The event that started a run (an event trigger, features/triggers).

RunOriginOut.title: RunOriginOut
RunOriginOut.description: Where a run was asked from, when not the app: by voice, from a phone.

RunTiming.title: RunTiming
RunTiming.description:
How long an answer took, from the server's records (service.run_timing).

The duration is `finished_at - started_at - waiting_ms`. While the run waits for
the user, `waiting_since` says since when; that time isn't part of the duration
either. Compare the times with the server's clock, not the browser's: every API
response has it in its `X-Server-Time` header (milliseconds since the epoch).

Scope.title: Scope
Scope.description: Restricts a rule to workspace roots (top-level folders). "*" means any.

ScriptCode.title: ScriptCode
ScriptCode.description:
What a version of a script is: its code and what the code may use. All of it is
reviewed together: changing any part is a new version.

ScriptCreateIn.title: ScriptCreateIn
ScriptCreateIn.description:
A new script from the app: approved at once (the user wrote or saw it), off
until it is switched on.

SetupSettings.title: SetupSettings
SetupSettings.description: The first-run setup: whether it is still to do, and where it was left.

Shape.title: Shape
Shape.description: A line or arrow from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2), or a rectangle or ellipse in that box.

SharedScreenOut.title: SharedScreenOut
SharedScreenOut.description: The shared screen without its content (the content only goes to the assistant).

SharedTabIn.title: SharedTabIn
SharedTabIn.description: What the extension sends: the same shape as a page attached to a message.

SharedTabOut.title: SharedTabOut
SharedTabOut.description: The shared tab without its content (the content only goes to the assistant).

SketchData.title: SketchData
SketchData.description: The drawing (version 1). Coordinates are in sheet units (CSS pixels at 100 %).

error.title: Error

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.description: Text a model read from the drawing

preview_current.title: Preview Current

items that have the tag: turning it into the value is offered, never done unasked.

blocked_by.title: Blocked By

properties.description: Property values (features/properties), e.g. {"client": "ludmyla-doula"}: select values are slugs, a multi_select a list, dates YYYY-MM-DD. tags is the same list as `tags`. On a change: the keys given are set, null removes one.

TriggerIn.description:
A trigger for an automation (the Automations page). Wake-me triggers are only made
by an agent in its chat (the create_trigger tool).
